_comment: Simplified Chinese texts for the German table rifts12. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.A Rift has opened under the Woadfen moor: Woadfen荒原下裂开了一道裂隙：根之裂隙。守望者Darrow守着它。
strings.A new Rift tore open east of Crowcrest:: Crowcrest以东撕开了一道新裂隙：迷雾裂隙。守望者Brisa迷失在里面。
strings.All three vanes catch the wind. The fog: 三只风向标都兜住了风。雾被撕开了！
strings.Climb the silent lighthouse on the Saltg: 登上Saltglass盐滩上沉默的灯塔，修复里面的暗影裂隙。
strings.In the dark nobody sees who moves first:: 黑暗中没人看得见谁先动：步速不再决定顺序。
strings.Mend every Rift and every Rift heart fir: 先修复每道裂隙和每颗裂隙之心。目标列表会告诉你还剩哪些。
strings.Mend the Root Rift under the Woadfen moo: 修复Woadfen荒原下的根之裂隙。Kestra在入口等着。
strings.Mend the three Rifts: the Cinder Rift pa: 修复三道裂隙：Thornridge那头的余烬裂隙、Crowcrest以东的迷雾裂隙、Saltmarsh下的潮汐裂隙。
strings.The Mist Heart crackles! Lightning flick: 迷雾之心噼啪作响！雾中闪过电光。
strings.The colour drains away again. Start with: 颜色又褪去了。从第一条根重新开始。
strings.The far end won't give. Somewhere behind: 远端打不开。你身后某处还有一道裂隙开着。
strings.The fog knots itself into one grey heart: 雾纠结成一颗灰色的心。它从四面八方向你飘来！
strings.The fog still knots itself together at t: 迷雾裂隙的中心，雾仍在纠结成团。
strings.The last root glows, and the tangle pull: 最后一条根亮了，缠结的藤蔓让开了！
根接住了颜色，亮了起来。
strings.The roots glow softly. The way stays ope: 根柔和地发着光。路一直开着。
strings.The silent lighthouse on the Saltglass f: Saltglass盐滩上沉默的灯塔里藏着一道裂隙：暗影裂隙。
strings.The vane creaks round. A thin wind start: 风向标嘎吱转了过来。一缕细风吹了起来。
strings.The vanes turn on their own now. The pat: 风向标现在自己转了。小路一直畅通。
strings.The wind swings round and the fog rolls: 风转了向，雾又卷了回来。重新开始。
strings.Thick fog: every art on both sides is le: 浓雾：双方所有技艺的命中率下降。
strings.Vines creep in: each round they mend the: 藤蔓爬了进来：每回合治疗前排最弱的Spirling。
strings.Maelis: The water still hums those five: Maelis：水还在哼着那五个音。我已经不再问它是唱给谁听的了。
strings.Orrin: Mirela's tear stayed shut. I sit: Orrin：Mirela的裂口始终没有打开。我还是坐在这儿。老头子总得有个地方犯错。
